The '''R-88 Suppressor riot rifle''' was a medium-size [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and used to put down riots and insurrections on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The R-88 was used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the Old Republic, Empire, and New Republic days, but it was more popular with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]], who used it frequently during the Imperial era.

==Description==
The R-88 was a nonlethal pacification device with a blast radius to scale with the effect of a [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]] and the precise aiming of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle. They were used to subdue rioters in a hurry. Two cylindrical tanks clipped under the weapon's barrel carried [[Brix-C stun fluid/Legends|Brix-C stun fluid]], which was fired in a compressed stream to diffuse in an aerosol rain over the targets. Either inhaling the aerosol cloud or absorbing it into the skin was enough to render a target unconscious, though [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] and full-body coverings proved to be effective counter-measures against the R-88.<ref name="CorCWorld" />

These weapons were most notably used by the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CoreGuard" /> However, the R-88 Suppressor was also used during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to quell riots and urban unrest.<ref name="CorCWorld" />
